products.title: Leather Golf Scorecard Holder
products.body_html:
Handmade to order. Ships in 2–3 business days.

The details matter. Always have. This leather scorecard holder is built for golfers who appreciate the quieter parts of the game: the walk, the feel, and the tools you carry along the way.

Cut and stitched by hand in a timeless, vintage style, each one is finished with a subtle Clutch touch inside, our signature flag logo stamped on the interior. It's not loud. It's not flashy. It's just right.

Details:
• Genuine leather exterior
• 4.5 x 7.5 inches closed, 1/2 inch thick: slim enough for a back pocket
• Fits scorecards, StrackaLine and other popular yardage books
• Clean stitched edges
• Interior stamped with the Clutch flag logo
• Handmade in the USA

Make it yours: initials, a name, custom text or a logo. After you order, email your design details to help@clutchgolfcompany.com with your order number, and we'll confirm before we stamp it. Bulk and event orders and general questions go to the same address.

products.title: Hickory Alignment Sticks
products.body_html:
Handmade to order. Ships in 2–3 business days.

Three patterns. Eleven colorways. Pick your pattern, then make it yours.

Real hickory alignment sticks, handmade in the USA and finished in your choice of 11 colorways. Each pair is two 42-inch, 3/8-inch sticks built to keep your setup square and your aim true, with a lot more character than fiberglass rods.

Choose your colorway

The Originals (where Clutch started): Classic Green, Heritage Blue, Heritage Stripe, Seersucker
Harbour series (bold three-color bands): Harbour Town, Blue Devil, Overcast
Fairway series (the Midnight Fairway pattern in four colorways): Midnight Fairway, Tomahawk, Greenskeeper, Gator

  • Two 42-inch hickory sticks per pair
  • Hand-finished colorways, handmade in the USA
  • Use them for aim, ball position, swing plane and putting drills
  • Several colorways have a matching hardwood club brush, and every pair fits our handcrafted leather stick cover

Line it up like a legend.
